comment: Chart symbols in order of legibility at small print sizes: the most used colours get the first ones. 'noto' = Noto Sans Symbols 2, 'atk' = Atkinson Hyperlegible Bold. Similar-looking letters/digits (I O Q 0 1 2 5 8, b d p q) are left out on purpose. Also left out after normalisation: X (looks like ✖), ✗, ⬥ ⬦ (same as ◆ ◇), ⧫, ▯ (too thin).
